Criteria:

Technical issues: no formal mission objectives, requirements, performance metrics such as resolution, revisit, latency, coverage. Bathymetry and thermal-stress monitoring proposed without instrument or data-product requirements.

C2 Project plan — mark 6/10 Adequate (18/30). Reasoning: Gantt chart and task descriptions make plan feasible and linked to launch, orbit, ground and comms work. Lacks contingency provisions and deeper justification, so not fully Accomplished. Evidence: "Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart."; "Completed stages are gold. Incomplete stages are blue. Deadlines are indicated by red lines."; Useful Links. Technical issues: Gantt chart lacks contingency, dependencies and explanation of grey cells; only one deadline line evident. Sources bare URLs/footnotes rather than full citations; several links not cited in text. Acronyms COEs and AOEs undefined, no sensor or data-relay architecture specified. R2 partial, R3 yes, R4 yes, R6 partial.

C3 Preliminary progress — mark 4/10 Adequate (4/10). Reasoning: Some preliminary work evident through research and STK tutorials, but no technical results, calculations or design interpretation. Fits minor work completed. Evidence: "completed STK tutorials 1, 2, 3 & 4." Technical issues: no actual orbit, launch or space-segment design calculations; only planned tasks. Preliminary progress limited to reading and STK tutorials; no technical results or interpretation shown.

C4 Report presentation — mark 7/10 Accomplished (14/20). Reasoning: well structured, readable, consistently formatted. Gantt figure clear and footnotes match in-text markers, though references informal URLs and figure lacks formal caption. Evidence: quote coral reefs; Image 1; Useful Links. Technical issues: sources bare URLs/footnotes rather than full citations; several links not cited in text. Gantt lacks contingency etc but that's C2. C4 accomplished-low.
